cases.name: rate-24000
cases.reason: Below 48 kHz the first packet now drops the decoder's 2.5 ms delay, as at 48 kHz; 2026.10.7 kept part of its ramp-in, so later packets sit a few samples later. Sunshine always streams 48 kHz.

cases.name: pack-stereo-code2-lossy
cases.reason: A lost packet is concealed for the negotiated packet interval rather than the last frame's 2.5-5 ms, so the playout clock keeps the stream's cadence.
